# apple_user (Data Source)

Looks up a team member by App Store Connect ID or email.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "apple_user" "dev" {
  email = "dev@example.com"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `email` (String) Email address of the user, in any case. Set this or `id`.
- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the user. Set this or `email`.

### Read-Only

- `all_apps_visible` (Boolean) Whether the user can see every app.
- `first_name` (String) First name of the user.
- `last_name` (String) Last name of the user.
- `provisioning_allowed` (Boolean) Whether the user can access Certificates, Identifiers & Profiles.
- `roles` (Set of String) Roles of the user.
